create_buffer_trajectory: create a Buffer instance with observation and action specs to pre-allocate trajectory storage
append_transition_buffer: append a timestep action and new timestep transition to the sequence buffer
drain_buffer_trajectory: drain the sequence buffer and return the accumulated trajectory as a Trajectory named tuple
check_buffer_empty: check if the sequence buffer is empty before attempting to drain transitions
check_buffer_full: check if the sequence buffer is full before appending new transitions
